summary: Presents a timing model for sources, destinations, and transit nodes in Deterministic Networking (DetNet), and a methodology to compute end-to-end latency and backlog bounds for various queuing methods. This supports bounded latency with zero congestion loss. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Some machines need messages to arrive on time, every time. This gives the math for working out the longest wait a message will ever have along its route.

questions: how to compute detnet latency bounds
what is bounded latency in deterministic networking
